scope: Primary motor-control research and exact candidate IDs; no new biological function inferred from local model motion.

evidence_levels.experimental: Manipulation/recording in biological flies under stated conditions.
evidence_levels.connectomic: Observed reconstruction or curated annotation in a named specimen/version.
evidence_levels.model_prediction: Result or mechanism of an explicitly parameterized simulation.
evidence_levels.adapter_proposal: Our proposed mapping to body-model coordinates; not a biological finding.

sources.title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome
sources.interpretation_limit: Single adult female brain and VNC; structural control motifs, not measured complete dynamics.

sources.title: Fine-grained descending control of steering in walking Drosophila
sources.method: Optogenetics, single-cell current injection, kinematics, connectomics
sources.interpretation_limit: DNa02 and DNg13 target different stride components; soma and axon side differ for DNg13.

sources.title: Neural circuit mechanisms for steering control in walking Drosophila
sources.interpretation_limit: Steering association does not establish sole necessity of DNa02.

sources.title: Distributed control of motor circuits for backward walking in Drosophila
sources.method: Genetic circuit dissection, optogenetics and kinematics
sources.interpretation_limit: MDN branches LBL40 and LUL130 have distinct backward-step contributions.

sources.title: Two brain pathways initiate distinct forward walking programs in Drosophila
sources.method: Independent genetic driver lines and optogenetic behavior
sources.interpretation_limit: P9 forward-initiation evidence; driver-dependent freezing discrepancy.

sources.title: Speed dependent descending control of freezing behavior in Drosophila melanogaster
sources.interpretation_limit: DNp09 response depends on pre-stimulus behavioral state.

sources.title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control
sources.method: DN stimulation, population calcium imaging and behavioral interventions
sources.interpretation_limit: DNp09 recruits a broader descending population.

sources.title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila
sources.interpretation_limit: BRK active braking differs from suppression of descending walk commands.

sources.title: A size principle for recruitment of Drosophila leg motor neurons
sources.method: In vivo calcium imaging, electrophysiology, force probe
sources.interpretation_limit: Tibia flexor force-per-spike and recruitment differ across slow, intermediate and fast units.

sources.title: Synaptic architecture of leg and wing premotor control networks in Drosophila
sources.interpretation_limit: Muscle modules and motor-neuron size support recruitment hypotheses.

sources.title: Neural Coding of Leg Proprioception in Drosophila
sources.method: Controlled tibia movement and calcium imaging
sources.interpretation_limit: FeCO subtypes encode distinct movement and position features.

sources.title: Selective presynaptic inhibition of leg proprioception in behaving Drosophila
sources.interpretation_limit: Hook sensory transmission is selectively gated during self movement.

sources.title: Proprioceptive limit detectors contribute to sensorimotor control of the Drosophila leg
sources.interpretation_limit: CxHP8 posterior reflex and altered swing-to-stance transition; other hair plates partly predictive.

sources.title: Motor neurons organize Drosophila feeding sequences via a disinhibitory cascade
sources.method: Simultaneous quadruple-electrode recordings, behavior and modeling
sources.interpretation_limit: Central circuit and muscle effects of motor-neuron glutamate differ; exact neuron IDs not extracted.

sources.title: Glutamate receptor composition at Drosophila neuromuscular junctions depends on developmental stage and muscle identity
sources.interpretation_limit: Adult receptor composition differs by muscle; proposed extrasynaptic tone regulation remains hypothetical.

sources.title: Organization of circuits linking descending input to motor output in the Drosophila Male Adult Nerve Cord connectome
sources.interpretation_limit: Anatomical DN-to-MN pathways; synapse count is not conductance.

sources.title: Sexual dimorphism in the complete Drosophila male central nervous system connectome
sources.method: Whole male CNS reconstruction and comparison
sources.interpretation_limit: Independent specimen supports cross-dataset checks; IDs remain separate.

sources.title: NeuroMechFly v2, a framework for simulating embodied sensorimotor control in adult Drosophila
sources.interpretation_limit: Physics and sensor interfaces are reusable; built-in controllers are modeling choices.

sources.title: Whole-body physics simulation of fruit fly locomotion
sources.method: MuJoCo model, motion data and learned control
sources.interpretation_limit: Torque actuators and learned policies do not supply per-neuron muscle physiology.

sources.title: Connectome simulations identify a central pattern generator circuit for fly walking
sources.interpretation_limit: CPG necessity is computational; DNg100 and DNb08 activation have behavioral evidence.

sources.title: Pugliese et al. 2026 data
sources.method: Original simulation archives and experimental data
sources.interpretation_limit: Run configuration and neuron parameters retained in each simulation folder.

sources.title: BANC neurotransmitter prediction pipeline
sources.interpretation_limit: Only detected synapses size>5 are classified; not muscle receptor physiology.

sources.title: Neurotransmitter ground truth
sources.interpretation_limit: Study-level evidence and matching confidence need preservation.

sources.title: Codex official FAQ: left/right inversion
sources.interpretation_limit: Corrected annotations do not change historically inverted images.

root_id may belong to a later materialization; use banc_888_id for v888 edges.
fafb_match and other crosswalks describe homology; multiple BANC cells can share a target.
